text: Bakkaatu fawaaki on nde ɓaƴƴiŋton faale mo'on ƴamde suddiiɓe ɓen fewndo eddinagol; wano wiide mo: si edda maa on timmii, humpitam. Bakkaatu fawaaki on e kon ko suuɗoton faale mo'on ƴamde ɓe si edda maɓɓe on timmii. Alla No Anndi on annditoyay fii maɓɓe, saɓu tiiɗugol mon yiɗugol ɓe, O Daginani on ngol ɓaƴƴingol. Reŋtee fodondirgol ƴamal fewndo edda; si wanaa kon ko dagorii ɓaƴƴingol. Wata on humu kadi dewgal fewndo edda. Nganndee pellet Alla No Anndi kon ko suuɗoton e pittaali mo'on; immorde e ko O Dagini maa ko O Harmini, reenee e Makko, wata on lunndo Yamiroore Makko. Nganndon pellet Alla ko Haforanoowo ɓen tuubooɓe e jeyaaɓe Makko, Muññiiɗo Mo yaawnantaako ɓe lepte.
